narration.text: One of these tools is completely free and still the best.

At number five, we have Simplified. This platform is an all-in-one content creation suite, combining an AI writer, designer, and even a video editor. It is perfect for streamlining your entire social media workflow.

Coming in at number four is Opus Clip. If you create long-form video content, this tool is a game-changer. It automatically transforms your lengthy videos into viral-ready short clips, saving you hours of editing time.

Our number three spot goes to Canva Magic Write. Integrated directly into the popular design platform, Magic Write quickly generates text for any design you are working on. It is incredibly useful for crafting engaging captions and headlines.

Taking the second spot is ChatGPT. While not a dedicated social media tool, its ability to plan a month of posts in minutes is unmatched. Use it to brainstorm ideas, draft captions, and even create content calendars.

And the top spot, number one, goes to CapCut. This incredibly powerful and free all-in-one video editor includes advanced AI features. It lets you create professional-looking videos directly on your phone or desktop, making it essential for any social media creator.
CapCut is truly indispensable for quick and engaging video content. Did we miss your favourite AI content tool?
